 Mother Finds 12000 Dollars in Teen Daughter's Closet 
 Mother Finds 12000 Dollars in Teen Daughter's Closet

 A confrontation over $12,000 in cash has drawn widespread attention online after a mother discovered the money in her 16-year-old daughter's shoebox. The video, shared by TikTok account AshleyTvShow (@ashleytvshow), shows the mother questioning how her daughter obtained the money, pointing to her new Prada shoes and two phones, and threatening to call the police. According to The Mary Sue in an article published October 20, 2026, the video had received more than 247,000 views.
 The teenager did not disclose the source of the money, leaving viewers divided over the mother's concerns and the daughter's privacy. The mother questioned how her daughter could afford expensive belongings without a job. She also expressed concern about the teenager's unexplained cash and challenged her over her spending.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 The daughter, meanwhile, repeatedly questioned why her mother had searched through her closet and demanded the return of her belongings. Rather than providing a detailed explanation, she offered a brief response during the argument.

 Sophie Raworth Joins Cirencester Parkrun Ahead of Festival 
 The teenager addressed her mother directly, saying, "Mama, I had to do what I had to do," according to the video described by The Mary Sue. Her response did not clarify how she had obtained the money. The mother warned that her daughter could face jail time and threatened to contact the police, apparently suspecting that the cash might have come from illegal activity.
 The dispute escalated when the teenager disclosed that she had stopped attending school. The admission added another source of conflict, with her mother expressing anger over the prolonged absence and insisting that she should have completed her education. The video did not establish whether the daughter had committed an offense or identify any source of income. The teenager maintained that she had to do what she needed to do, but offered no further explanation in the footage described by The Mary Sue.
 Online reactions reflected disagreement over how the mother handled the discovery. Some commenters argued that possessing a large amount of cash does not, by itself, establish illegal activity. One viewer wrote, "Making money is not a crime," while another questioned the proposed police involvement, asking, "how is that grounds for the cops to come".
 Also Read 
 Cat Deeley Wears M&S Lace Top on This Morning 
 Other commenters suggested possible explanations for the money without providing evidence about the teenager's actual circumstances. One speculated, "Maybe she is reselling," while another wrote, "She probably saved it for years."
 Some viewers focused instead on the mother's decision to search her daughter's belongings. One commenter asked, "why is she going all through her closet anyway."
 Other reactions accused the mother of being interested in the cash rather than her daughter's welfare. One viewer claimed, "She just want the money she dont even care about her," while another joked, "I trust my mum she’s keeping half before the confrontation." Not all viewers criticized the mother's response.
 Also Read 
 Massachusetts Couple Discovers Four Shared Catholic Sacraments 
 One commenter supported her position, writing, "mom is right my parents would have called the cops dad would say not in our house." Another viewer took a similarly strict stance, stating, "if you’re doing wrong you have to get out of my house."
 The Mary Sue's account of the video did not identify the origin of the $12,000 or establish whether authorities were contacted. The teenager's source of income remained unexplained in the footage described by the publication.
